normal_linux_driver_policy.reserve_timestamp: Returns owned page-aligned object subranges, not whole-window backing
normal_linux_driver_policy.map_timestamp: Maps the actual requested BO physical extent with firmware shared RW protection

selected_cold_trial_policy.backing: One additional fresh zero Linux-owned RAM page
selected_cold_trial_policy.existing_work_stamp_addresses: Preserved and still mapped through their original owners

uncertainty: We have not bound every first-job firmware timestamp access or special-object offset to the new16KiBpage. Queue/context slot confinement must not be claimed. Native aperture base binding and actual backing are proved; chosen firstobjectextent is experimental.
diagnostic_limit: An out-of-page access may still fault or stall this trial; mapping onepage alone does not guarantee dispatch or rendering.
